exactSourceUnion.method:
Audit source-domain triangle unions with exact rational vertical integration.

All stored barycentrics are first deserialized as IEEE f32, lifted to exact
dyadic rationals, normalized by the complete row sum, and clipped to the source
simplex. A rational segment arrangement partitions x into slabs; interval union
boundaries are linear inside each slab, so their area integrals and both directed
differences are exact. GLB world area is used only for the final units conversion.
This independently checks floating-point GEOS overlay on very thin source masks.
exactSourceUnion.after: r17 triangle dictionaries are exactly identical to audited r14; source-union-identity-proof.json records both file hashes and equality proof
exactSourceUnion.geosCaveat: Floating-point GEOS overlay falsely reported a 0.030677213 mm2 loss and similar duplication on node175 face35946. Independent f32-normalized rational integration instead proves loss 3.911795498805269e-14 m2 and duplicate exactly zero on that face; exact-source-union evidence is authoritative.

precision.worldZeroDefinition: Promote stored f32 world endpoints to f64; reject only a cross product exactly equal to zero, not a positive area below an arbitrary cutoff.
precision.netDifferenceIsNotWorldZeroSum: Per-piece discarded source areas overlap prior retained coverage, and f32 barycentric encoding moves boundaries. Their sum is not the map union loss. All positive union losses and gains are reported separately.
precision.sourceEncodingQuantization: Across 1069 source faces, positive directed loss exceeds that face's summed world-zero areas by a total 1.7756456010514587e-10 m2; this comparison is diagnostic, not an exact disjoint attribution. Maximum positive excess on trunk face1871 is 4.025804860137595e-12 m2. These positive encoding changes are disclosed separately from world-zero rejection. Disposition: documented for this revision as f32 source-boundary precision; no mathematical zero-loss claim. No original-triangle backstop is added and mathematical zero loss is not claimed.
precision.locatorInterpretation: UV microcharts provide a representable locator, including an explicit minimum height and offset-dependent minimum length. The true source/world metric controls physical decal dimensions. Locator dimensions are not physical geometry.

sourceHinges.method: Exact GLB source identity and normalized stored-f32 source-domain Fractions, clipped to the original source simplex, original edge parameter [0,1], and a strictly inward <=1 micrometre band. The physical band limit is proved against exact rational squared distance. Only exact-positive strip areas contribute; every positive common projected interval is retained and rounded inwards to f32, otherwise generation fails. Runtime clips projected output to existing masks. The band does not fill a geometric or paint-mask gap.

semanticLimits.sourceFace2351: Two disjoint trunk masks separated by a true 10.60484 mm gap remain disjoint; projection clips to existing triangles and creates no gap coverage.
semanticLimits.sourceFace32590: Source node175 face32590 belongs to front-left-fender near the left mirror root. Two historical rear-bumper ghosts total 5.288732 mm2 and must not be restored. The highlight image is location evidence behind the mirror, not direct exterior visibility proof.

semanticLimits.visibilityAreaLimit: A ray witness does not establish that the whole containing polygon is exposed or paintable. Native paint-switch material does not by itself approve an exterior paint mask.
semanticLimits.completenessClaim: Reviewed body domains only; no claim of 100 percent whole-car exterior completeness.
semanticLimits.degenerateUV0Review: Eight assembled-ray-visible seam/return-lip source faces were individually reviewed and excluded from this revision ordinary exterior painting domain. They are not described as hidden or left awaiting UV re-unwrap; no ordinary broad-panel omission was confirmed by these images.

publicPhysicalFrames.absoluteNormalDotInterpretation: Plane-normal comparison permits reversed UV orientation; no all-signed-normal-equivalence claim.

authoredSeams.sampling: every seam: 0.2/0.5/0.8 edge position, 10% inside source triangle, both directions; 7 spatial strata/pair add wide+tall rotations and 700mm square
authoredSeams.metricDefinition: singular values of generated image_uv*sizeMm differentiated against intrinsic physical world millimetres; expected [1,1]. Thin clipped output fragments excluded from numerical derivative only; coverage areas retain them.

originalSourceHinges.scope: Every authored source hinge, both directions, 300mm square anchored on largest raw-world same-source-face/part fragment. Differentiate emitted imageUv*300mm against raw world millimetres; compare with public source tangent axes rotated independently around the original shared GLB line. Original interiors come from stable raw world/source-barycentric affine inverse, not production private frames. Hinge support remains the production gate; missing and numerically unusable witnesses remain explicit.

multiFragmentSourceFaces.scope: Every multi-fragment (part,sourceMesh,primitive,sourceFace) with largest stored f64-world-area seed >1mm2. Public centroid locate and 300x300mm same-part coverage. Expected targets have stored-world area >0.01mm2 and centroid distance <100mm. These thresholds select substantial witnesses; they do not discard smaller source domains from geometry. Missing target lists retain chart, own-centroid lookup, distance and normal evidence.

desktop.scope: Real desktop IPC, native HWND visibility/sibling hit-tests and GPU submissions; GPU PNGs are readbacks, not OS composition screenshots

wholeCarNativeGpu.maskEncoding: little-endian f64 normalized x/y; 6 values / 48 bytes per triangle
wholeCarNativeGpu.scope: Real PNG import and uploaded image bytes, per-side viewport_probe image-UV to GPU color matches, latest submitted document/selection/focus frames. At least three matching probe pixels per side; not three distinct colors. Alternating reflection and rotations +31/-23 degrees at 540x360mm. GPU readbacks, not OS composition screenshots. Representative seeds do not prove every possible decal placement.

runtimeValidation.renderSubmissionBarrier: renderedRevision and camera status advance only when gpu.frames actually increases; recoverable skipped frames remain dirty for retry.

checks.scope: final map and camera; then new f64-mask regression independently checked in full 28-test renderer suite
Final release binary is a local build artifact; binary hash is recorded separately to avoid a report/embedded-manifest hash cycle.

reproduction.prerequisites: Commands run from repository root, except cargo commands explicitly run from next/. Python requires numpy and shapely. All output directories must be fresh because tools refuse overwrite. The local reviewed geometry, visibility, r4 repair and hinge manifest under next/.reports are required inputs and are not committed to GitHub. A clean clone cannot regenerate raw OEM resources or these reviewed inputs from this summary alone.
reproduction.toolValidation: Seven asset scripts passed py_compile and git diff --check. Exact rational area code passed analytic identical, crossed, contained and duplicate triangle cases.
